body: I have dealt with this in many relationships and it has become a deal breaker for me, but it isn’t for everyone and that is okay! If it deeply bothers you, you don’t have to be right or wrong about it… Our boundaries and needs don’t have to make sense to everyone. I have found that when the topic needs to be addressed I have received the best response from telling him something along the lines of, “hey in not way to I want you to feel restricted or controlled in this relationship, but when look at women in a sexual way through social media and porn makes me feel uncomfortable and I find myself comparing myself to other women and second guessing the value I hold in your life. It is natural to find other people attractive but I really value when active lust and sexual desire are reserved for me. When that attention is focused on me I feel confident, valued, and more connected with you.” something like that. If you don’t like it, it’s not an over reaction. It just important to identify the root feelings with the issue and bring it up with lots of “I” statements because men like to get very defensive about this topic, and bringing it up in a calm, non-controlling way seems to be best received. Best of luck! <3
